data: Zenodo 571258 data.zip, MD5 3a04d2671229560dc1684c9dedd17c4d; three site CSV files only.

partitions.exploration: first 50 percent of each ordered site sequence
partitions.validation: next 20 percent of each ordered site sequence
partitions.final_holdout: last 30 percent of each ordered site sequence

baseline: Independently specified linear calibration using amedas as response and ek, solar, humid, azimuth, and altitude as predictors. The published ANN is a source comparator, not reproduced unless its environment is separately certified.
primary_analysis: Fit only on the frozen training portion; report MAE for raw ek and linear calibration on validation, then run final holdout once after validation implementation freeze.
robustness: Repeat the fixed chronological split at each of the three source sites.
Report each site separately; do not pool site outcomes into a universal claim.
Retain abrupt-condition boundary as an interpretation limit rather than selecting split dates from error results.
claim_boundary: Any result concerns time-ordered transfer for these recorded sites and periods, not all low-cost sensors, climates, or long-term drift.
prohibited: Do not inspect final_holdout outcomes before a committed validation implementation and independently certified reserve.
